top5.summary_zh: AI 安全研究机构 METR 经 11 周调查后发布报告称，Anthropic 正用 AI 构建更强的 AI，其模型改进速度约为一年前的两倍，且几乎没有放缓迹象。
top5.why_it_matters_zh: 若 AI 加速自身研发的趋势持续，可能显著加快能力提升节奏，这正是安全研究者担忧的核心。
top5.title_en: METR report: Anthropic is automating AI R&D, with models improving roughly twice as fast as a year ago
top5.summary_en: A new report from AI safety research organization METR, following an 11-week investigation, says Anthropic is using AI to build more powerful AI, with its models improving roughly twice as quickly as a year ago and little sign of slowing.
top5.why_it_matters_en: If AI-driven acceleration of AI development continues, it could markedly speed up capability gains, which is the core concern for safety researchers.
top5.what_zh: 据 The Verge 报道，AI 安全研究机构 METR 经 11 周调查后发布报告称，Anthropic 正用 AI 构建更强的 AI，其模型改进速度约为一年前的两倍，且几乎没有放缓迹象。
top5.what_en: According to The Verge, AI safety research organization METR published a report after an 11-week investigation saying Anthropic is using AI to build more powerful AI, with its models improving roughly twice as quickly as a year ago and little sign of slowing.
top5.why_zh: 若 AI 加速自身研发的趋势持续，可能显著加快能力提升节奏，这正是安全研究者担忧的核心。
top5.why_en: If AI accelerating its own R&D continues, it could markedly speed up capability gains — the core concern for safety researchers.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 这是第三方机构 METR 的调查结论，属值得跟踪的信号而非已确立趋势；“两倍”为报告所述指标，需结合报告原文核实口径与时间范围。
top5.editor_judgment_en: This is a third-party METR finding — a signal to track, not an established trend; the 'twice as fast' figure is as reported and its metric and time scope should be checked against the original report.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：更快的研发自动化可能压缩模型迭代周期；风险：能力提升加速可能超出安全评估与治理节奏。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: faster R&D automation could compress model iteration cycles; risk: accelerating capability gains may outpace safety evaluation and governance.
top5.action_zh: 阅读 METR 报告原文，核实“两倍”指标的定义、样本与时间范围。
top5.action_en: Read the original METR report and verify the definition, sample and time scope behind the 'twice as fast' figure.
